title: Find the Boundary
text: The function changes definition at $$x=4$$. Check whether the two pieces meet there.

title: Left-Hand Limit
text: As $$x$$ approaches $$4$$ from the left, use g(x) $$=$$ $$\sqrt{x}$$: lim x→4⁻ $$\sqrt{x}$$ $$=$$ $$\sqrt{4}$$ $$=$$ $$2$$.

title: Right-Hand Value
text: As $$x$$ approaches $$4$$ from the right, use $$g(x)=2x$$. The right-hand limit is $$24=8$$.

title: Classify
text: The left-hand limit is $$2$$ and the right-hand limit is $$8$$. Both are finite but unequal, so there is a jump discontinuity at $$x=4$$.
